EXAM MECHANICS PARTIALLY HEDGED: Minnesota's motorcycle knowledge test is genuinely mandatory for essentially all first-time applicants -- confirmed via the manual itself (Preface, p.I: 'Minnesota tests everyone seeking permits and license endorsements') and dps.mn.gov's motorcycle-license page (requires passing 'the state knowledge test for the motorcycle instruction permit' before the permit, which is separate from and prior to the Basic Rider Course; the BRC skills-test waiver only waives the on-cycle skills test, per manual p.VIII 'Basic Rider Course (BRC)'). However, neither the manual nor dps.mn.gov/drive.mn.gov publishes an exact item count or passing percentage for the knowledge test anywhere checked this session. Third-party test-prep sites (driving-tests.org, zutobi.com, epermittest.com, dmv-written-test.com, dmv-permit-test.com) consistently and specifically report a 40-question test requiring 32 correct (80%) to pass; this is NOT officially confirmed by MN DPS and MUST be flagged as an unconfirmed stand-in in the EXAM_CONFIGS code comment at wiring time, same convention as other hedged tracks (e.g. nc_motorcycle, pa_motorcycle, tx_motorcycle).
